text:
sam: Quick async sync for onboarding orcaX-13B -> serving readiness. TL;DR: weights + tokenizer quirks + quant readiness (AWQ primary, GPTQ backup, FP8 fallback). Need quick ack for canary config and calibration sample size.

maria: Where are the finalized weights? I saw a few S3 copies. Which URI should ops use?

sam: Use s3://redwood-models/orcaX-13B/release/v1/packed_weights.tar.gz — that's the canonical. I updated model-metadata.json in the same folder.

jordan: Noted re: tokenizer: there's a mismatch for BOS handling — some corpora expect BOS=50256, others use index 1. I hit a padding bug in token offsets.

linh: Can you paste the tokenizer config snippet? I can patch the loader to normalize BOS to 1 during onboarding.

sam: Patch snippet sent below (quick):
```json
{"tokenizer": {"bos_token_id": 1, "eos_token_id": 2, "pad_token_id": 0, "special_tokens_map": {"bos": "<s>"}}}
```
Use tokenizer_normalize=true in model config.

maria: OK, I'll add that to the serving config. Also: is the kv-cache path stable for the canary? We don't want warm-start misses.

sam: kv_cache_dir=/mnt/kvcache/orcaX-13B/v1 (will be rsynced during deploy). Ops, please ensure permission to that path.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job: canary-orcaX-13B-v1 -> phx-region. Start time: 2026-05-06T17:00:00Z. Params: replicas=3, quant_profile=awq, fallback_profiles=[gptq,fp8].

jordan: On quant vs accuracy: AWQ gives ~0.7% drop on our dev eval (qa_f1 macro), GPTQ ~0.4% drop but 2x memory, FP8 better perf but slightly higher variance on long-context tasks. We need to decide tradeoff thresholds.

sam: Proposed acceptance: AWQ OK if delta <= 1.0% on the core 10k eval set and no regression >2% on any single task. If AWQ fails, try GPTQ; if GPTQ fails, FP8 as last resort.

maria: For calibration dataset: propose 2000 prompts sampled stratified across long/short contexts and safety-sensitive categories. That matched previous canaries.

linh: 2k samples sounds fine. Running calib with --seed 42 should be reproducible. Command I used: `calib-run --model-orig s3://... --out /tmp/calib --sample 2000 --seed 42 --profile awq`

calib-bot: calib-run completed (pre-run) -> summary: sample=2000, expected runtime ~18m, estimated token count ~1.1M, baseline f1=0.912, awq_pred=f1~0.905 (delta -0.7%). Full artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/calib/2182345678/pre_run_report.html

jordan: That pre-run delta matches my local numbers. If we accept AWQ, can we add an extra eval for summarization (long context) as a guardrail? AWQ tends to degrade there.

sam: Good call — add long-context subset of 300 examples with emphasis on summaries & multi-turn. We should require no >1.5% drop on that subset.

maria: I'll add both checks to the canary gating step in CI. Also opening CR for the tokenizer_change: https://git.internal/redwood/serve-config/pull/342 (ping @maria @linh for review)

linh: Reviewing CR now, will comment inline. Small ask: make quant_profile explicit in service yaml so it doesn't rely on default. Example snippet:
```yaml
service:
  model: orcaX-13B:v1
  quant_profile: awq
  fallback_profiles:
    - gptq
    - fp8
  kv_cache_dir: /mnt/kvcache/orcaX-13B/v1
```

sam: Can people DM :thumbsup: here to approve the plan? I want to collect approvals before I hit the canary start. Canary window is 17:00 UTC tonight.

maria: :+1: I approve the AWQ gating thresholds and sample sizes. I'll merge the tokenizer CR after CI passes.

jordan: :+1: I'll monitor the long-context eval during canary; will raise if >1.5% drop.

linh: :+1: Ops checked kv cache permission. Also added a quick healthcheck script to warm the cache before traffic: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh orcaX-13B v1`

sam: Thanks all. I'll kick the canary once CR merged and CI ok. If anything blocks, please ping here.

maria: One more logistic — tagging support for a 1hr on-call window during canary (to triage regressions). @oncall: can you confirm?

sam: I'll message @oncall separately.

deploy-bot: Canary started (2182347600). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/logs/canary-orcaX-13B-v1/2182347600

sam: Starting monitoring and will post quick summary after the 30m warm window.
